title: Formally unramified stalk maps imply a formally unramified scheme morphism
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Suppose that for every $x\in X$ the actual stalk homomorphism $f_x^\sharp:\mathcal O_{S,f(x)}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is formally unramified: for every $\mathcal O_{S,f(x)}$-algebra $A$, every ideal $J\subseteq A$ with $J^2=0$, and any two $\mathcal O_{S,f(x)}$-algebra maps $u,v:\mathcal O_{X,x}\to A$ whose composites with $A\to A/J$ agree, one has $u=v$. Then $f$ is formally unramified [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism]. No local finite type, finite presentation, quasi-compactness, or nonemptiness hypothesis is required.
